scientific_role: Implementation-fidelity and store-retrieve eligibility gate only; no lifecycle score is a paper result.

method_groups.gate: Construct, ingest a fixed two-turn fact, finalize, snapshot, retrieve, and verify non-empty auditable evidence under the declared shared local stack.

special_checks.MGMemory: Exercise trigger, summarizer, recall, and archival encoder paths; record that this is the benchmark-bundled implementation.
special_checks.A-Mem: Require non-empty extracted metadata and retrieval; record the local OpenAI-compatible LLM and embedding substitutions.
special_checks.Omni-SimpleMem: Use a real image attachment in addition to text; verify a visual MAU or image-linked retrieval item rather than a text-only pass.
special_checks.MIRIX: Verify isolated MIRIX_DIR, all intended memory agents, configured embedding dimension, padded storage dimension, and retrieval without a silent fallback.

method_groups.gate: Requires the exact frozen GME revision and a verified 1536-dimensional multimodal endpoint before construction. Every method must ingest and retrieve both text and a real image.
method_groups.prohibited_substitution: The existing 1024- or 384-dimensional Qwen3 embedding services cannot be used as GME.

method_groups.gate: Requires the exact frozen 8B revision, image-and-text encode checks, correct served-model identity, and dimension consistency before a numerical run.

admission_rule: A method may enter a full numerical prefreeze only after its method-specific lifecycle root is terminal-accepted, independently hashed, and reviewed for silent fallbacks and model-identity mismatches.
failure_rule: Seal failed attempts as terminal-rejected; diagnose and prefreeze a fresh recovery root. Never repair or resume a terminal root in place.
scheduling_rule: Do not run GPU lifecycle gates or model downloads that can perturb the active Wave-1 controller. Prepare manifests and code audits now; execute after Wave-1 releases the service stack.
comparison_boundary: Only accepted full-split local runs populate numeric cells. Pending or failed methods stay visible with empty cells; official paper numbers remain in a separate evidence layer.
